observations: Grey fabric sofa with vertical channel tufting on the backrest and armrests.
Visible dark spots or damp patches on the seat cushion in photo 0.
Watermark 'HEART OF GOLD FUNITURE' and 'POSTED ON JIJI' present on photo 0.
The item is situated in a warehouse or showroom with other furniture visible in the background.
The sofa appears to be a compact 2-seater or a very wide armchair.

claims.evidence: Frame strength cannot be determined from a static image.
Uniqueness is a subjective marketing term.

risks.risk: The dark spots on the seat cushion may be permanent stains or oil marks.
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the seat cushion or a video showing the fabric being brushed.
risks.if_unproven: priced as permanently stained and requiring reupholstery

risks.risk: The internal wooden frame or springs may be cracked or sagging.
risks.proof: A video of a person sitting and moving on the sofa to check for noise or excessive sink.
risks.if_unproven: priced as having structural frame damage

risks.risk: The back and underside of the sofa may have tears or poor finishing.
risks.proof: Photos of the rear and the underside (bottom) of the unit.
risks.if_unproven: priced as having damaged backing fabric

proof_requests: Clear, well-lit photo of the seat cushion to identify the nature of the dark spots.
Video of someone sitting on the sofa to test frame integrity.
Photos of the back and the underside of the sofa.
Dimensions (width and depth) to confirm if it is a 1-seater or 2-seater.
response.reason: The item is clearly identifiable as a small sofa. It can be priced based on its visible condition, assuming the worst case for the visible stains and unverified structural integrity.
